title: Can You Pay for Your Own Growth? SpaceX, Meta and the Cost of A.I.
description: The A I boom doesn't have a demand problem. It has a paying-for-it problem. SpaceX reveals that A I is now its biggest business, Meta's cash flow turns negative, and power-equipment stocks tumble as rates sit near five percent. Plus: why electricity is the new A I bottleneck, what Anthropic's coming I P O could reset, and where the factory jobs are.
